title: fix(app-shell): Re-seed / Purge keep the refusal code and render ENVIRONMENT_KERNEL_UNAVAILABLE as a terminal refusal
body:
Fixes #10432
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`reseedSampleData` and `purgeSampleData` (in `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceApi.ts`) returned `{ ok: false, error: readApiError(payload, res).message }`. They kept the refusal's text and dropped its code. In the 5xx band that text is the control plane's withheld generic sentence (cloud#1145), and the code is the one member that still says which fault occurred. That is the consumer half of cloud#2072.

- **`marketplaceApi.ts`**: both calls now return `{ ok: false, error: message, code }`, destructured from `readApiError` the same way `call()`, `installPackage` and `installLocal` already do. The return type is a named `SampleDataActionResult` (`ok`, `error?`, `code?`); purge adds `deleted?`. `code` is absent only when no response arrived (a network error, or a missing installation id refused before the request). `readApiError` itself is unchanged.
- **`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`**: `doReseedSampleData` / `doPurgeSampleData` branch on `errorCodeIs(r, 'ENVIRONMENT_KERNEL_UNAVAILABLE')`, the helper this page already uses for the local-install codes. On that code the page renders `marketplace.detail.sampleDataKernelUnavailable` and sets `cloudSampleDataRefused`. That flag disables BOTH cloud sample-data menu items for the rest of the visit, because the code is a fact about the deployment and neither action can succeed there. Every other code, `INTERNAL_ERROR` included, keeps today's path: the response's own text in the banner, and both items stay enabled.
- **`packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`**: one new key, `marketplace.detail.sampleDataKernelUnavailable`, placed beside the neighbouring sample-data keys in all ten locale packs.
- **`.changeset/10432-reseed-purge-error-code.md`**: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

Status handling is untouched: nothing reads `res.status` any differently. No copy was added for any code other than the one that arrives.

## ⚠️ Declared reading gap: the sentence was not copied from the cloud doc

The card says the two sentences are already written in cloud `docs/design/installation-action-refusals.md`. That repository is not reachable from this session. The REST contents read of that path answered 403 ("GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session"), the same read on this repo answered 200 as a control, and `add_repo` for `objectstack-ai/cloud` answered "you don't have access". So the sentence here is written from the card's own statement of what the code means: this control plane has no environment kernel, so the action cannot run here, and it must be run from the environment's own runtime.

> en: This control plane has no environment kernel, so sample data cannot be re-seeded or purged from here. Do it from the environment's own runtime.

The repo carried no existing sentence to reuse: `git grep ENVIRONMENT_KERNEL_UNAVAILABLE origin/main` found 0 hits, and the same `git grep` form found `INTERNAL_ERROR` in 5 files under `packages/` as a control. A reviewer who can read the cloud doc may want the wording aligned with it. That changes only the ten locale values, not the key.

## Premise checks against `origin/main` `ab50ccc`

- **H1, holds.** At the base, the `readApiError` call sites in `marketplaceApi.ts` are `call()`, both `installPackage` paths, `installLocal`, `reseedSampleData`, `purgeSampleData` and `uninstallLocal`. Only the last three keep `.message` alone. `uninstallLocal` is the local-runtime manifest uninstall behind `doUninstallLocal`. It is not on the Re-seed / Purge path, so it is left alone (see Acceptance notes). The local Re-seed / Purge (`postLocalSampleAction`) does not use `readApiError`, and it already attaches `code` to its thrown error.
- **H2, holds.** Both dialects `readApiError` reads for a code are pinned at HTTP 500: the nested envelope `{ error: { code, message } }` and the `failWithCode()` sibling `{ error: 'TEXT', code }`. `readApiError.test.ts` shows these routes answer in both.
- **H3, holds.** See the reading gap above.
- **H4, measured.** Before this change, a failed cloud Re-seed / Purge rendered its text in the inline `role="status"` banner (with a Dismiss button). Both menu items stayed enabled (`disabled` read only `sampleDataBusy`, plus `withSampleData` for purge), so the same action could simply be picked again. There is no toast and no explicit Retry button. The retry offer was the still-enabled menu item, and that is what this change disables, for this one code only.
- **H5, not reachable.** The `@object-ui/app-shell` `exports` map has two entries: `.` (`./dist/index.js`) and `./styles.css`. `src/index.ts` has 0 `export *` lines (control: 63 `export {` lines) and re-exports nothing from `marketplaceApi`. Only the page components are exported, and `MarketplacePackagePage`'s signature is unchanged. So the widened return type does not reach the published surface, and `Clause-②: no` stands as claimed.

## Tests: red on the base, green on the head

New pins:

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/sampleDataRefusalCode-10432.test.ts` (unit): for each of the two calls, a 500 carrying `ENVIRONMENT_KERNEL_UNAVAILABLE` in the nested envelope and in the sibling dialect comes back with that code beside the withheld sentence. `INTERNAL_ERROR` comes back as itself.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.sampleDataRefusal-10432.test.tsx` (dom): a Re-seed or a Purge refused with the kernel code renders the new key, not the withheld text, and both menu items then carry `aria-disabled="true"`. CONTROL: `INTERNAL_ERROR` renders the response's own text and leaves both items enabled.

Red leg: after committing, the two source files were checked out from the base `ab50ccc` with a restore trap. Marker counts on disk moved from page 3 / api 2 to 0 / 0, and the old spelling moved from 0 to 2. Result: `Tests 8 failed | 2 passed (10)`. The 6 unit cases failed on `expected { ok: false, …(1) } to deeply equal { ok: false, …(2) }`. The 2 kernel page cases failed on `Unable to find an element with the text: «marketplace.detail.sampleDataKernelUnavailable»`. The 2 INTERNAL_ERROR page controls passed on the base, as a control should. Restore: both blob hashes equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

Green leg on the head: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 10 passed (10)`.

Ablations (`ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit x1 to x0, blob changed, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty), each run against the kernel page pins:

- Dropping `cloudSampleDataRefused` from the Re-seed item's `disabled`: 2 failed, on `expect(reseed).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true')`.
- Dropping it from the Purge item's `disabled`: 2 failed, on `expect(purge).toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true')`.

So each half of "no retry offered" is pinned on its own.

## Gates, all read at head `82f916e`

This repo has no `dispatch-gates.mjs`, so the families below were picked by hand from the root `package.json` scripts and `.github/workflows/`. Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- Dependency closure `turbo run build --filter="@object-ui/app-shell^..." --concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: both echoed `type-check$ tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, both `Done`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both new test files, with `readApiError.test.ts` as the control.
- Tests, from the repo root: `vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/` gave `Test Files 85 passed (85)`, `Tests 1248 passed (1248)`. The whole `packages/app-shell/` ran in four shards: 1/4 `195 passed (195)`, `1933 passed | 1 skipped`; 2/4 `194 passed | 1 skipped (195)`, `1748 passed | 8 skipped`; 3/4 `195 passed (195)`, `2226 passed`; 4/4 `195 passed (195)`, `1786 passed`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: `14 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`. `pnpm changeset:check`: fixed group OK, and no `major`.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: `OK (scanned 8518 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)`. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`: every in-scope call-site key resolves against the en pack. `pnpm check:i18n-drift`: `0 en value(s) changed (1 key(s) added, 0 removed)`. `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` is a report; the new key is not listed in it.
- `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots` and `check:pending-changeset-literals`: all OK. `pnpm check:changeset-claims` is report-only, and its self-contradiction reading passed.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 15 changed paths: `NOT GOVERNED`.
- ESLint is narrowed, not run repo-wide. The measurement has three parts. ① Population: both packages lint with `eslint .` under the root `eslint.config.js`, whose `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` blocks cover every changed source. ② Count, from `--format json`: 4 app-shell files and 10 locale files, with 0 errors. Warnings match the base exactly (`marketplaceApi.ts` 36 to 36, `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` 11 to 11), and the new tests have 0. ③ Invariance: the config sets no type-aware `parserOptions`, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads other files, so this diff cannot move the verdict of any untouched file.
- No doc gate is reached: the diff touches no `README.md`, `content/docs/**` or `docs/**` file.
- CI had not concluded when this was opened. The PM reads it.

## Acceptance notes

- `uninstallLocal` still throws `new Error(readApiError(payload, res).message)` and drops the code. It is not on this path and no consumer branches on its code today, so it is not changed here.
- Once the maintainer can read cloud `docs/design/installation-action-refusals.md`, the ten locale values may be aligned with its wording (see the reading gap).
- The refusal flag is component state. It holds for the visit and clears on a reload, and on a kernel-less control plane the next attempt re-arms it with the same sentence.
